exposure: Cystic fibrosis-related diabetes mellitus (CFRDM) diagnosis timing (pre-conception vs. during pregnancy)
cohort: 15 pregnancies in 12 women with CFRDM who attended the National Maternity Hospital Dublin for obstetric care between 2015 and 2019
finding: Women diagnosed with CFRDM pre-conception were more likely to require caesarean section, be treated with insulin, and have frequent hospital admissions for CF exacerbations.
mod_finding: The majority (62.5%) of women with CFRDM diagnosed pre-conception delivered via caesarean section.
